about:
Emmaus Foods LLC operates its manufacturing facility and corporate office in Albertville, Alabama, in the heart of the poultry industry. The privately held limited liability company employs approximately 500 team members. While the food-focused business does not state a founding year, the company's steel fabrication lineage traces to the April 1989 incorporation of Steel and Fabrication Industry, organized by veterans with sixty years of combined experience in steel fabrication, machining, and design.

The company serves two distinct lines: custom food manufacturing for national chain, food service, and hospitality customers, and heavy steel fabrication. The fabrication shop produces custom industrial tanks (including stainless steel), structural steel for commercial and industrial buildings and bridges, stainless steel ducting for semiconductor facilities, stacks for emissions compliance, pressure vessels, cyclones, scrubbers, fan housings, ductwork, hoppers, dampers, slide gates, filter housings, conveyors, and dewatering screen cabinets. It also offers industrial coating services. The operation is supported by a team of certified craftsmen, engineers, and designers.

Customers span the food industry — national chains, food service operators, and hospitality providers — as well as the semiconductor sector (for ducting), commercial and industrial construction (for structural steel and stacks), and a range of other industries that use coated or fabricated steel equipment.

Emmaus Foods emphasizes a "special culture" centered on its team members, aiming to maintain a safe and pleasant workplace. The steel fabrication business was founded to fill a gap left by large manufacturers reducing their in-house fabrication capacity, offering a higher level of excellence in steel fabrication with a commitment to quality and efficiency.
